title: Omit unlimited pids limit for rootless cgroupfs
body:
Rootless with cgroupfs (WSL machines) an explicit unlimited pids limit (`--pids-limit -1`/`0`, or the `PidsLimit: 0` every Docker client sends) still reaches crun, which fails with "controller `pids` is not available". The default path already omits the limit there. Drop an unlimited limit in that case, so `docker run -d` and `docker compose up -d` work again. Finite limits are unchanged.

Fixes #29909

```release-note
Rootless with the cgroupfs manager, an unlimited pids limit no longer fails when the pids controller is not delegated.
```
